MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 156

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 82
   D. 9

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

10. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 29

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
